name: Jarl Needs a Blade
summary: "Swamp Eye" Jarl, in Dustwallow Marsh, has cutting to do and will not say what. Jarl wants a certain blade, a moonsteel broadsword, and does not want you to dawdle.

sections.title: A Certain Blade
sections.body: "Swamp Eye" Jarl has cutting to do, and cannot say what is to be cut. Jarl needs a particular blade, which some call a moonsteel broadsword and Jarl calls a swing blade. You might find one in town, or a blacksmith might make one special. Jarl warns you not to sleep on it, since what is to be cut will not keep forever.

faq.q: Who is asking for the blade?
aliases: who gives jarl needs a blade
faq.answer: "Swamp Eye" Jarl, who is found in Dustwallow Marsh.
A moonsteel broadsword, which Jarl calls a swing blade.

faq.q: Why does Jarl need a blade so urgently?
aliases: why does jarl need a blade
faq.answer: Jarl has cutting to do, cannot say what is to be cut, and warns that it will not keep forever.

faq.q: Where does Jarl suggest finding the sword?
aliases: how to get moonsteel broadsword for jarl
where to find blade for jarl
faq.answer: Jarl says you might find one in town, or talk to a blacksmith who can make it special.
